params.1273: Harvest a crop of rosemary from a flower patch.
params.1274: You will need a rosemary seed. You can pickpocket these from master farmers (with sufficient Thieving), buy them, or play Vinesweeper for them.
params.1275: Rosemary is grown in a flower patch; these tend to be found in the centre of allotments such as the one south of Falador.
params.1276: The presence of rosemary protects cabbages in adjacent vegetable patches from becoming diseased.
